title: beautifull vanilla
description:
A clean and optimized Minecraft texture pack that improves blocks, items, and UI while keeping the original vanilla style.

Designed for smooth performance, it enhances visuals without heavy shaders, making the game look better and more modern on any PC.
body:
This resource pack enhances Minecraft’s visuals while keeping the original vanilla feel.

It improves over 100+ textures including blocks, items, and UI elements to create a cleaner, more modern look without changing the core style of the game.

The pack is designed to stay lightweight and optimized, making it perfect for smooth gameplay even on low-end PCs.

Features:
• Improved blocks and environment
• Cleaner and more detailed items
• Updated UI for a better experience
• Performance-friendly (no heavy impact on FPS)

Perfect for players who want a better-looking Minecraft without losing the classic vibe.
